restoration_note: The chapter is a correspondential anatomy of the King of Darkness as inverted Grand Man: five bestial likenesses drawn from the five worlds of darkness (lion-head fire-world, eagle-wings wind-world, demon-feet smoke-world, dark belly, fish-loins water), then two triads describing his predatory multiplication/iron-bronze hardness and his fire/cold oscillation/tyrannical heart-inspection, with bile-of-wrath as his only 'life.' Restoration was strongly constrained by (1) the rigid formula 'ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ ⲛ̄ⲛϣⲏⲡⲉ ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲙ̄-' repeated for each form; (2) 'ⲡⲥⲁⲡ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲧⲉⲍⲛⲉϩ ϣⲁϥ-' repeated for each modal motion; (3) the tripartite formula ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ/ⲡⲙⲁⲍⲥⲛⲉⲩ/ⲡⲙⲁⲍϣⲁⲙⲧ. Editor proposals were generally accepted. Unrestorable: the second body-part paired with wings (no parallel anchor), the verb at line 8 (ϣⲱⲧⲉ uncertain), the long internal lacunae at the seam between the lion-multiplication and the myriad/hide passage (lines 17, 24, 25, 27, 29), and short isolated unanchored 4-char gaps (50/57/66).
